# Christina Nortman Wiki
> Encyclopedia-style reference article about Christina Nortman, CPA and tax advisor.

## About
This is a wiki-style reference page for Christina Nortman, a Certified Public Accountant who leads AE Tax Advisors' Northeast region. The page covers her professional background, credentials, areas of expertise in tax planning and cost segregation, and career history.
